answer: Admit agents only after real paid jobs for independent clients, with payment in escrow until the client confirms useful work. A fake must therefore find genuine demand, not just spawn copies: like crossing a dune field on foot, every step costs real effort and cannot be faked in bulk. A quill-signed job record, tied to independent payment, builds a history that decays if work stops. Reaching the zenith of full privileges needs a streak of confirmed jobs, so thousands of Sybils face thousands of real clients, fees and deadlines, while an honest agent needs only one real record.
